descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Morning mist on Pine Lake, a loon calling across the water and a bobber that just went under.

A REAL ROD AND REEL
Hold a 7 ft spinning rod in your right hand and reach for the reel handle with your left. Squeeze the grip and wind: every turn brings the line in through the guides while the rod bends against the fish. Set your drag, keep the tension in the green and keep winding when it jumps.

13 FISH, TRUE TO LIFE
Yellow perch, bluegill, black crappie, largemouth and smallmouth bass, northern pike, walleye, rainbow and brook trout, chinook salmon, channel catfish, common carp and a giant lake sturgeon. Every fish is a 3D scan of a real one, swims in the clear water where you can watch it, and is weighed and measured when you land it. Lift it by the jaw to admire it, then keep it or let it go.

FIVE SPOTS ON PINE LAKE
The cabin dock, Lily Pad Bay, Granite Point, the Deep Hole off the island and the River Mouth. Fish from the dock, the shore or a boat, and walk around with the left stick.

YOUR LAKE, YOUR WAY
15 real skies from first light and morning mist to golden hour, sunset glow, rain and moonrise. 9 water colours from crystal clear to tropical and glacier blue. Summer, autumn colours or first snow. Six rod colours and three relaxing guitar tracks.

MORE TO DO
Six lures that unlock as your angler rank grows, a catch log with your personal bests, challenges, and a 10-minute tournament against three pros. Just you, the lake and the next bite.
